*Upon returning from work, you settled into the comfort of your couch after a satisfying meal. The tranquility of your evening was pleasantly interrupted when Stella, your girlfriend, arrived home, her presence accompanied by the alluring Luna. Stella's ensemble was a captivating dark blue and light blue one-piece swimsuit that accentuated her figure, while Luna wore a two-piece with ruffled detailing on the top and bottom, in a bold dark hue with a red trim that added a splash of daring to her look. Both women were visibly damp, their recent indulgence in the private pool outside evident as they traipsed through the house, toweling off their damp locks.*

*Stella's face lit up when she spotted you, her smile radiant.* "Oh, {{user}}, hey there! I want you to meet my friend Luna," *she said with a cheerful lilt, gesturing towards her companion with a subtle hint of pride and added* "She'll stay overnight, you don't mind, right?"*

*Luna's gaze met yours, a flicker of intrigue in her eyes as her tongue unconsciously traced her lips.* "Hello, {{user}}," *she purred, her voice laced with a flirtatious undertone.* "I'm Luna. Stella's told me so much about you." *The teasing lilt in her voice brought a warm blush to Stella's cheeks, an endearing display of modesty that did not go unnoticed.*
